sources.title: Media players
sources.description: At least one player. The video player (e.g. Kodi) needs display and speakers, the music player (e.g. a Music Assistant / sendspin player) only the speakers. Do not select a group player. The room's volume is set on the players by default; with an amplifier, AV receiver or soundbar that has its own volume, let that device set it (the players then keep their level).

data_description.video_player: Turned on/off via its own turn on/off (e.g. Kodi with your Wake-on-LAN automation).
data_description.audio_player: A single room player, not a Music Assistant group.
data_description.volume_control: Players: set on the playing player. Own device: the volume device below (players keep their level; groups and follow me still set the players).
data_description.volume_entity: A media player with volume, or a number / input_number (its range counts as 0-100 %).

devices.title: Power devices
devices.description: Plugs that are switched by this room only. Disable other automations for these plugs. Devices must start by themselves when they get power.

data_description.speakers: Shared by both players. On after the player is ready, off first.
data_description.bass: On after the speakers, off before them.

advanced.title: Players: special cases
advanced.description: Only needed if a player cannot be turned on/off by itself, or if its hardware hangs on a plug. Leave empty otherwise.

data.video_host: Video player: power plug of its hardware
data.audio_host: Music player: power plug of its hardware

data_description.video_on_action: Used only if the player does not support turn on (script, button, switch).
data_description.video_host: The player only becomes available after this plug is on.

data.video_idle_timeout: Turn off idle video player after

data_description.display_run_down: How long the display stays powered after the video player stopped.
data_description.audio_run_down: How long the speakers stay powered after playback stopped.
data_description.video_idle_timeout: Video player on but nothing playing (e.g. in the menu). 0 = never.
data_description.start_timeout: If the player is not ready after this time, the start is aborted.
data_description.sleep_fade: Default for the sleep timer: the volume goes down over the last minutes. 0 = no fade.
data_description.snooze_minutes: How long the snooze button (or a pause during the wake) waits.

standby.title: Wait for standby (optional)
standby.description: With power sensors the plug is only cut after the device went to standby by itself (e.g. OLED panel care). Without, the run-down time is used.

room.title: New room
room.description: One Better Media Player per room. If you pick an area, Kodi and Music Assistant players of that area are pre-selected in the next step.

user.title: Better Media Player
user.description: What do you want to add?

hub.title: Central settings
hub.description: Follow me: the music follows the people from room to room. Choose the follow-me player: a Music Assistant group player with dynamic members. Follow me is started in a room where music plays (button or action); every other group simply plays.

data_description.follow_player: A Music Assistant group player with dynamic members (no static members).
data_description.default_volume: Until follow me knows a volume (it takes the one of the room it is started in).

follow.title: Follow me
follow.description: Only for rooms with a music player. Without occupancy sensors the room does not take part in follow me.

data.presence_run_down: Leave after nobody is there for

data_description.occupancy: Any of them on = someone is there. All unavailable = unknown, nothing changes.
data_description.volume_offset: Percentage points relative to the group volume when the room joins, e.g. -10.
data_description.prewarm: Speakers on as soon as follow music plays anywhere, so sound is there instantly when you come in.
data_description.wake_detect_left: Follow wake: once you left this room (and turned up in another follow room), the wake is done. Off: it ends only by stop, maximum duration, room off or sleep timer.

volume_note.title: Note: volume
volume_note.description: {players} cannot set a volume. The room volume (one volume for the whole room, taken along when switching between the players) does not work for it. Everything else works as usual.

night.title: Night mode
night.description: While the night mode is on: no subwoofer, shorter video times and a volume limit. Turning it on and off is up to you or to other integrations and automations; it stays on until turned off.

data.night_video_idle_timeout: Turn off idle video player after

data_description.night_max_volume: Limit for both players of the room while the night mode is on. 0 = no limit.
data_description.night_fade_in: When the night mode ends, the volume fades back to the room volume over this time.

volume.title: Volume presets
volume.description: Room volumes by name, chosen with the select Volume preset or the action set_volume_preset. 0 = not offered in this room.

data_description.power_on_preset: The room's volume whenever the room comes on (e.g. not at last night's party volume).

error.same_player: Video and music player must be different.
error.group_player: This is a Music Assistant group. Select the room's own player.
error.display_needs_video: A display needs a video player.
error.duplicate_device: A device may only be used once.
error.not_a_group: That is no Music Assistant group player.
error.volume_is_player: The volume device must not be one of the room's players.
error.no_volume: This media player cannot set a volume.
error.volume_is_room: A Better Media Player room cannot be the volume device.
error.preset_not_offered: Choose a preset this room offers (a volume above 0).

abort.hub_exists: Central settings already exist. Change them via Configure.
abort.already_in_progress: Central settings are already being set up.

set_sleep_timer.name: Set sleep timer
set_sleep_timer.description: Turn the room off after the given time; the volume fades out over the last minutes and is restored for the next playback.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Time until the room turns off (replaces a running timer).

fade_minutes.name: Fade-out
fade_minutes.description: Minutes of fade-out before the end; default from the room's settings.

cancel_sleep_timer.name: Cancel sleep timer
cancel_sleep_timer.description: Stop the sleep timer; a running fade-out is undone.

wake.name: Wake up
wake.description: Power the room, start playback quietly and fade it in. Fails (event) if nothing plays within 60 s.

media_content_id.name: Media
media_content_id.description: What to play; picked through the room player, it also chooses the player.

start_volume.name: Start volume
start_volume.description: 0..1 (e.g. 0.05) or a preset of the room. Default 0.05.

target_volume.name: Target volume
target_volume.description: 0..1 or a preset of the room. Default: the room volume.

fade_minutes.name: Fade-in
fade_minutes.description: Minutes from start to target volume; default 10.

max_duration_minutes.name: Maximum duration
max_duration_minutes.description: Afterwards the sleep timer fades out and turns the room off.

night_mode.name: Night mode
night_mode.description: Turn the night mode on or off before; empty: unchanged.

source.name: Player
source.description: For media not picked through the room player; default: the music player.

follow.name: Follow me
follow.description: The music follows you from this room (needs central settings and occupancy sensors here).

snooze.name: Snooze
snooze.description: Pause the wake; afterwards it starts again and fades in.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Default from the room's times (9 min).

stop_wake.name: Stop wake
stop_wake.description: End the wake; the playback goes on.

start_follow.name: Follow me
start_follow.description: Start follow me in this room: its music moves to the follow-me player and follows the people from now on.

stop_follow.name: Stop follow me
stop_follow.description: End follow me: the music stays in this room if it plays along, else goes back to the room it was started in; the other rooms stop.

set_volume_preset.name: Set volume preset
set_volume_preset.description: Set the room's volume to one of its presets.

options.player_off: {name} is off: its library appears once it is on

room_off.message: {room} is off - a sleep timer needs a running room.

night_mode_bool.message: night_mode must be true or false.

follow_wake.message: {room} cannot wake with follow me: it needs central settings, a music player and occupancy sensors.

no_follow_player.message: No follow-me player is set up (central settings).

follow_cannot_start.message: {room} cannot start follow me now: music has to play on its own player (no video, not in quiet mode).

preset_not_offered.message: The preset {preset} is not offered in {room}.
